name: DEPU GM130
notes: Pre-launch: 'Launching soon on Kickstarter' (sign-up page only, no price disclosed). Desktop simultaneous 5-axis mill with A/C trunnion (A +90/-90 deg on the campaign page, +/-130 deg on depu.com; C continuous 360 deg), table dia. 130 mm, max workpiece dia. 130 x 100 mm, max load 10 kg. Working area = X/Y/Z travel. Feed = rapid traverse (cutting feed 0-8 m/min). Spindle 3 kW (100% ED), phi80 water-cooled, ISO20, 6-tool ATC (depu.com also mentions 40,000 rpm max; the spec table says 24,000 rpm). Weight and dimensions only from depu.com/GM130, which shows an earlier design render. Integrated cooling system (type not specified). Proprietary DEPU CNC system with Chuixiang AI CAM.
